role: The shared entity rasterizer's interface: a clip-space vertex and the render target with the fixed-function GL modes each entity pass sets (overlay, blend, cull, depth func, alpha test, lighting, vertex colour).

structs.name: entity_raster_target
structs.java: the GL state an entity renderer runs under (fog, lightmap, GL_CULL_FACE, glBlendFunc, GL_DEPTH_FUNC, GL_ALPHA_TEST, GL_LIGHTING)

notes: raster_entity_quad is defined in raster_entities.c. Included by raster_entities.c, raster_hand.c, raster_particles.c and raster_worldfx.c; raster_mobs presumably uses it through raster_entities.h (not checked). lane/entrender: the blend modes 5 to 7, depth_lequal, tex_matrix, sample_tex.
